name: Knight Ignis
source:
"The crimson flames are the sword of justice!!"

She is a magical girl belonging to the secret society "Morning Star Knights", which aims to dominate the world with magic abilities. She has a strong sense of pride and believes that magical abilities exist to help the weak, but she shows open hostility towards persecution of ability holders by the powerless.

She is called the "Crimson Knight" for her lovely and graceful appearance, but she also has an uncontrollable side when she becomes emotional, and some fear her as the "Crimson Witch".

She fights valiantly with a baton imbued with the power of flames that matches her image color. She has fought Arty Rain many times and they both recognize each other as worthy opponents.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/QscKOhh.jpeg]Part 1 official character description[/url]]

[spoiler]During the second part, she was appointed as the acting branch chief of the Morning Star Knights' Japanese branch due to a certain incident, and as a result, she has gained composure, softened her demeanor, matured in appearance, and increased her feminine charm.
As a result, not only has her popularity within the Knights skyrocketed, but she has also gained fans in the school.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/4T3t9zi.jpeg]Part 2 official character description[/url]][/spoiler]
